summary: Refactored Composer.svelte and MessageList.svelte by extracting ComposerToolbar.svelte and ConversationPlaceholder.svelte, adding message-rows.ts for row flattening, and modernizing Svelte 5 patterns (shorthand props, {@attach}-friendly action return, on:→on directive cleanup). All affected files are now under 300 LOC (Composer 250, MessageList 227, ComposerToolbar 125, ConversationPlaceholder 27, message-rows 66, composer-actions 34).
decisions: Extract the Composer's attachment/send/stop toolbar into ComposerToolbar.svelte, receiving store + props from Composer, to keep Composer.svelte under 300 LOC.
Reuse existing ComposerCommandMenu, ComposerAttachments, and ComposerModelControls subcomponents rather than further splitting them.
Introduce ConversationPlaceholder.svelte to own the loading-skeleton and empty-state markup previously inline in MessageList.svelte.
Add message-rows.ts to flatten grouped messages into virtualized MessageRow items (group, assistant text, tool), keeping MessageList.svelte focused on virtualization/scroll concerns.
Update composer-actions.ts autoGrow to return an arrow destroy function for consistency with Svelte 5 attachment-style actions (no behavior change).
